english.title: Aid / abet danger of injury to passenger load
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) aided, abetted, counselled or procured **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[motor vehicle,namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[trailer drawn by a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

when

(C)_[the number of passengers carried by it]_
(D)_[the manner in which passengers were carried on it]_
(E)_[the weight, position or distribution of its load]_
(F)_[the manner in which the load was secured]_

was such that the use of it involved a danger of injury to any person.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 40A of the Road Traffic Act 1988, section 44(1) of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale in any other case.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
